narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation and Supply Disruption
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (US-Iran, Israel-Hezbollah, Ukraine-Russia) intensify, with the Strait of Hormuz blockade persisting through Q3 2026 per EIA. The shooting down of a US Apache helicopter and Iran's retaliation falsify the 'one-and-done' thesis, driving oil prices higher and equity selloffs.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil and defense stocks; short S&P 500 and emerging market equities exposed to energy import costs.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Diverges
narratives.summary: Despite BTC's crash amid macro risk-off, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure continue, as evidenced by Janus Henderson's $300B+ partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs and MicroStrategy's dip-buying. This signals a structural shift where capital separates crypto from pure risk assets.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate Bitcoin on dips via futures or spot ETFs; long ENA token on partnership news.

narratives.title: Sticky Inflation and Fed Policy Dilemma
narratives.summary: Strong housing data (+3.2% MoM existing home sales) contradicts the Fed's softening narrative, suggesting inflation may remain sticky. Capital is pricing in higher-for-longer rates, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors and supporting the dollar.
narratives.trade_implication: Short long-duration Treasuries (TLT); long USD vs. JPY and EUR.
